using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test;

public class HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceTextEmbeddingGeneration_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        var endpoint = new Uri("https://api.huggingface.co/models/test");
        var httpClient = new HttpClient();

        // Act
        var result = HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensions.AddHuggingFaceTextEmbeddingGeneration(
            services, endpoint, httpClient: httpClient);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Single(services);

        var serviceDescriptor = Assert.Single(services);
        Assert.IsType<KeyedServiceDescriptor>(serviceDescriptor);
        var keyedDescriptor = (KeyedServiceDescriptor)serviceDescriptor;
        Assert.Equal(ServiceLifetime.Singleton, keyedDescriptor.Lifetime);
        Assert.Equal(typeof(ITextEmbeddingGenerationService), keyedDescriptor.ServiceType);

        // Verify the factory was called and used GetService<ILoggerFactory>()
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.WasGetServiceCalled);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();

        var mockLoggerFactory = new MockLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        var model = "test-model";
        var httpClient = new HttpClient();

        // Act
        var result = HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensions.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(
            services, model, httpClient: httpClient);

        Assert.NotNull(result);

        Assert.IsType<KeyedServiceDescriptor>(serviceDescriptor);
        var keyedDescriptor = (KeyedServiceDescriptor)serviceDescriptor;
        Assert.Equal(ServiceLifetime.Singleton, keyedDescriptor.Lifetime);
        Assert.Equal(typeof(IImageToTextService), keyedDescriptor.ServiceType);

        // Verify the factory was called and used GetService<ILoggerFactory>()
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.WasGetServiceCalled);
    }

    [Fact]

}

/// <summary>
/// Mock ILoggerFactory that tracks if GetService was called on it.
/// This verifies the service provider.GetService{ILoggerFactory}() call on line 188.
/// </summary>
public sealed class MockLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
{
    public bool WasGetServiceCalled { get; private set; } = false;

    public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider) => throw new NotImplementedException();
    public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => throw new NotImplementedException();
    public void Dispose() { }

    // This constructor is called when serviceProvider.GetService<ILoggerFactory>() resolves it
    public MockLoggerFactory()
    {
        WasGetServiceCalled = true;
    }
}
